questions.question: Find x if 3 : 5 = 12 : x.
questions.explanation: Product of extremes = product of means: 3 × x = 5 × 12 = 60, so x = 20.

questions.question: The fourth proportional to 2, 3 and 4 is
questions.explanation: Fourth proportional x satisfies 2 : 3 = 4 : x, so x = 3 × 4/2 = 6.

questions.question: The third proportional to 4 and 6 is
questions.explanation: Third proportional x satisfies 4 : 6 = 6 : x, so x = 6²/4 = 9.

questions.question: The mean proportional between 4 and 9 is
questions.explanation: Mean proportional = √(4 × 9) = √36 = 6.

questions.question: If 8 pens cost ₹96, the cost of 5 pens is
questions.explanation: One pen costs 96 ÷ 8 = ₹12. Five pens cost 5 × 12 = ₹60.

questions.question: Find x if 4 : x = 9 : 18.
questions.explanation: Cross-multiply: 9x = 4 × 18 = 72, so x = 8.

questions.question: 12 men can complete a job in 15 days. How many days will 20 men take?
questions.explanation: Men and days are inversely proportional. Man-days = 12 × 15 = 180. Days for 20 men = 180 ÷ 20 = 9.

questions.question: A car covers 240 km in 4 hours. At the same speed, the distance covered in 7 hours is
questions.explanation: Speed = 240 ÷ 4 = 60 km/h. Distance in 7 hours = 60 × 7 = 420 km.

questions.question: A bus covers 180 km using 12 litres of fuel. The fuel needed for 450 km is
questions.explanation: Distance and fuel are in direct proportion. 180/12 = 450/x, so x = 450 × 12/180 = 30 litres.

questions.question: If 4, x, 25 are in continued proportion, x equals
questions.explanation: In continued proportion 4 : x = x : 25, so x² = 4 × 25 = 100 and x = 10.

questions.question: Food for 40 soldiers lasts 30 days. If 10 more soldiers join, how long will the same food last?
questions.explanation: Total food = 40 × 30 = 1200 man-days. With 50 soldiers it lasts 1200 ÷ 50 = 24 days.

On a map, 1 cm represents 25 km. Two towns are 7.2 cm apart on the map. Their actual distance is
questions.explanation: Actual distance = 7.2 × 25 = 180 km.

questions.question: If x : y = 7 : 3, then (x + y) : (x − y) equals
questions.explanation: Let x = 7k and y = 3k. Then x + y = 10k and x − y = 4k. The ratio is 10 : 4 = 5 : 2.

questions.question: 6 men working 9 hours a day complete a job in 10 days. How many days will 9 men working 5 hours a day take for the same job?
questions.explanation: Total work = 6 × 9 × 10 = 540 man-hours. New rate = 9 × 5 = 45 man-hours per day. Days = 540 ÷ 45 = 12.

questions.question: A garrison of 500 men has food for 18 days. After 6 days, 100 men leave. For how many more days will the remaining food last?
questions.explanation: Total food = 500 × 18 = 9000 man-days. Used in 6 days = 3000. Remaining = 6000 man-days. With 400 men the food lasts 6000 ÷ 400 = 15 days.

questions.question: If (x + y)/(x − y) = 5/3, then x : y is
questions.explanation: By componendo-dividendo: x : y = (5 + 3) : (5 − 3) = 8 : 2 = 4 : 1. Check: x = 4, y = 1 gives 5/3.
questions.shortcut: x : y = (p + q) : (p − q) for (x+y)/(x−y) = p/q.

questions.question: 8 pumps empty a tank in 15 hours. How many pumps of the same kind are needed to empty it in 10 hours?
questions.explanation: Total work = 8 × 15 = 120 pump-hours. Pumps needed = 120 ÷ 10 = 12.

questions.question: The present ages of A and B are in the ratio 3 : 5. After 6 years the ratio becomes 2 : 3. A's present age is
questions.explanation: Let the ages be 3k and 5k. After 6 years: (3k + 6)/(5k + 6) = 2/3. Cross-multiplying: 9k + 18 = 10k + 12, so k = 6. A = 3 × 6 = 18 years.

questions.question: If a, 12 and 48 are in continued proportion, then a equals
questions.explanation: Continued proportion means a : 12 = 12 : 48, so 48a = 144 and a = 3.
questions.shortcut: Middle term squared = product of the extremes: 12² = a × 48.
